comment: Default-FAIL verification contract for T-003 (epic-136-phase4-mcp), populated only after reports/quality-gate/20260729T134605Z-epic-136-phase4-mcp-T-003.md recorded VERDICT: PASS (review-context reservation sequence 384 in reports/review-context/identity-ledger.json; 0 Critical / 0 Major / 5 Minor, every Minor classified Accepted by the evaluator). risk: high, required_workflow: tdd, stack: code. Extracts listGuardedFiles' body into listGuardedFilesWithDiagnostics and leaves listGuardedFiles as a byte-equivalent 1-line wrapper, with resolveGuardedDirectory called OUTSIDE and BEFORE the new error-collecting try/catch so the allowlist/denylist check still short-circuits first (security-spec.md B3, AC-005/006, BL-003/BL-006). The evaluator did not accept the report's structural table: it compiled listGuardedFiles from the pre-change blob 9091f96b and from the landed source and ran both over an identical 24-case battery (byte-identical output, same sha256 both sides), and reproduced the B3 mutation experiment (13 tests: 5 fail on the mutant, 3 controls green). Landing commits: a4977219 + e85fcf79, plus the separate commit d55ed3ef re-scoping TEST-006's Non-goal assertion to the 2 modules design.md:95-96 actually constrains -- adjudicated by the evaluator as a legitimate scope correction against requirements.md AC-006's own explicit carve-out, not a weakened test. The evaluator additionally filed the pre-existing walk/denylist defect it found as GitHub issue #220 (QG-003), out of scope here under BL-003/BL-006. The lint/typecheck/build/placeholder-scan/task-state-check/unit-tests/acceptance-tests/regression/requirement-traceability evidence logs under specs/epic-136-phase4-mcp/verification/qg/ were executed ONCE at HEAD aeaea6b2 -- the commit at which all 5 tasks have landed -- and are therefore referenced by all 5 contracts. This is deliberate and disclosed: T-001..T-004 all edit mcp/sdd-forge-mcp/src/tools/evidence.ts, the v1 schema and the committed dist/index.js, so a per-task re-run at each task's own commit would measure a tree that no longer exists on this branch. Each task's own per-commit red/green/dist-parity evidence is separate and unshared (specs/epic-136-phase4-mcp/verification/<task>/). placeholder-scan evidence records BOTH runs. Run A (all 7 changed production files) exits 1 with 8 findings; Run A' repeats the identical command over the identical 7 paths' content at the merge base 7f152ce5 and reproduces the SAME 8 findings -- measured delta introduced by this feature: ZERO. Provenance was read, not assumed: 5 are inside CHANGELOG.md's RELEASED history sections (lines 607/608/617/1745/1755, all below the '## Unreleased' section's CHANGELOG.md:3..80 span) where the marker words are the release note's own subject matter, and 3 are inside the third-party ajv library that esbuild inlines into the committed dist/index.js (ajv internals codegen_1/names_1/propertyInData). Run B -- the gating scope, i.e. the content this feature actually authored (the 3 changed src/*.ts, the v1 schema, USERGUIDE.md, and CHANGELOG.md's '## Unreleased' section extracted verbatim) -- exits 0. `passes: true` is recorded against Run B, with Run A/A' kept in the same log so the wider scan's red state is disclosed rather than hidden. This repository configures no separate lint tool for the MCP package (mcp/sdd-forge-mcp/package.json scripts: build/typecheck/pretest/test/golden:record). `npx tsc --noEmit` is the package's static-analysis command and is recorded as the evidence for both `lint` and `typecheck`, matching the established repository precedent in specs/ci-mcp/verification/*.contract.json.
